# TENSPACE

> TENSPACE is a Guangzhou factory supplying phone batteries, chargers, power banks, cables and earphones to wholesalers, with OEM logo and packaging.

Battery wholesale in Liwan, Guangzhou since 2013; TENSPACE brand since 2024. Address: 59 Yanjiang West Road, Liwan District, Guangzhou, China. WhatsApp +86 186 6469 0890, anna@tenspaceofficial.com.

## Facts
- Battery cells: A-grade; every batch checked before shipping
- Certificates: CE, RoHS, UN38.3
- OEM logo and packaging: about 30 days; small trial orders accepted
- Factory visits on site or by video
